purpose: Finish the runtime maturity layer around production-independent warehouse durability: dashboard decisions, alerts, drills, deploy/prune controls, continuity, and certification.
nonNegotiables: Production runtime must not depend on the external drive.
Production deployment must not depend on the external drive when production-local backup and restore proof are fresh.
The live database remains the operational source of truth.
The warehouse is backup, archive, replay, evidence, analytics, and mirror storage.
Destructive pruning is disabled until explicit scoped approval, fresh backup, fresh restore proof, dry-run hash, and post-prune verification exist.

phases.name: Dashboard Tier Cards
phases.test: Runtime summary exposes four durability tiers and the dashboard renders tier cards.

phases.name: Safe-To-Deploy Decision
phases.test: Deploy gate does not require the external mirror or local computer when production-local proof is available.

phases.name: Safe-To-Prune Decision
phases.test: Prune gate reports destructive pruning disabled by default and lists approval requirements.

phases.name: Storage Proof Registry Ingestion
phases.test: Backbone proof categories map to warehouse proof tables.

phases.name: Normalized CP04 Alerts
phases.test: Runtime alerts include project, dataset, tier, gate class, severity, observedAt, and nextAction.

phases.name: Failure Drill Command Suite
phases.test: Game-day drill cases cover local offline, external drive unplugged, backup, restore, disk, collector, and mirror catch-up.

phases.name: Deploy Gate Runtime Integration
phases.test: Warehouse summary returns deployGate for dashboard and API consumers.

phases.name: Prune Approval Runtime Flow
phases.test: Warehouse summary returns pruneGate with defaultDestructiveMode disabled and approvalRequired true.

phases.name: Data Quality Intelligence
phases.test: Runtime dataQuality score includes source freshness, backup, restore, provider, and mirror checks.

phases.name: Collection-To-Decision Lineage
phases.test: Runtime lineage links source events, proof links, and decision gates.

phases.name: Warehouse Cost/Value Scoring
phases.test: Runtime costValue scores warehouse bytes, mirror bytes, ingest bytes, and risk reduction.

phases.name: Recovery Confidence Score
phases.test: Runtime recoveryConfidence reports score and boolean proof inputs.

phases.name: Warehouse SLOs And Error Budgets
phases.test: Runtime sloBudget exposes status, remaining budget, total budget, and breaches.

phases.name: Business Continuity Mode
phases.test: Runtime continuityMode explains the local-offline and mirror-disconnected operating posture.

phases.name: Cross-Project Correlation
phases.test: Runtime correlation names Nous Hermes, investing-system, and khashi-vc.

phases.name: Automated Game Days
phases.test: Runtime gameDays expose expected outcomes for scheduled drills.

phases.name: Policy-As-Code
phases.test: Runtime policyAsCode lists enforceable deploy, mirror, and prune rules.

phases.name: Autonomous Remediation Suggestions
phases.test: Runtime remediation ranks next actions by priority and gate impact.

phases.name: Executive CP04 Review Packet
phases.test: Runtime executivePacket summarizes status, approvals, risks, and score.

phases.name: Full Runtime Certification
phases.test: Runtime certification includes a score, complete flag, and all 20 phases.
